scope: Individual mathematical review of A0 against reviewed R0 and actual conditional amplitude/augmented-row structure. No proof or implementation edits.
assumptions: Stationary parameters; exact supplied current and actual duration; zero-order-hold current on every interval; endpoint voltage observations; every interval propagated in order.
Constant 25 C equal to exact public 298.15 K reference, exact public linear OCV intercept and positive slope; no aging, uncertain calibration or physical discrepancy extension.
Eleven R0 amplitudes (z0,v10,v20,v30,q,R0,R1,R2,R3,H,B), q=1/Q and B=H*h0; five stationary shapes (tau1,tau2,tau3,kplus,kminus) with positive ordered tau and positive k.
kdir=gamma_dir/Q is the independent shape coordinate; varying amplitude q at fixed shape changes gamma accordingly.
Positive measurement standard deviations are fixed public/observed weights independent of queried amplitudes and shapes.
Real-arithmetic functional dependency of a finite prefix; this is not binary64 error analysis or physical-population validation.

findings.reason: R0 beta and conditional_packet.make agree on the eleven column positions. At reference temperature all known Arrhenius factors are one. The appended (V0-y)/sigma constant and z0/q/R0 columns are shape independent; each initial RC state and RC resistance column uses only its own tau; H and B use the chronological two-direction hysteresis recurrence.

RC E/u recurrences have only one branch shape, fixed input history and shape-independent initial coefficients. Hysteresis Eh/uh uses kplus or kminus at each signed interval and therefore their union across history. Rest retains Eh/uh. Finite induction, products and sums establish the claimed upper bounds, including arbitrary irregular intervals and sign changes within the stated family.
Independent enumeration of all 78 unordered column pairs reproduces groups 10,33,12,11,12 without overlaps or omissions; maximum union cardinality is three.

Mixed RC/RC and RC/hysteresis entries remain present. Gram PSD follows from sum of squares but separately approximated entries need not preserve PSD. The lemma does not imply posterior independence; QR/solves/prior transforms/marginalization can mix dependencies.

The 78 objects are continuous shape-dependent functions, not 78 stored constants for unknown-rate inference. Fixed-shape packed QR control, finite probes and this dependency lemma do not prove a finite exact continuous-rate basis, uniform approximation accuracy, useful query coverage or bounded target resources.

This receipt independently checks the mathematical map and existing augmented-row construction. It does not accept the separately arriving graph artifact, static-map test implementation, optimization A1, or any future continuous-rate representation.

independent_checks.actual_row_test: Capture conditional_packet.make pre-QR rows using an identity QR test substitute; 100 reference-temperature observations with mixed signed/rest current, irregular/zero durations; perturb each of five shapes individually by 10%.
independent_checks.meaning: Finite controls supplement the recurrence proof. They do not establish uniform approximation or physical validity.

remaining_limits: Handwritten conditional proof, not a machine-checked full-program proof.
No finite exact unknown-rate history compression, fitted continuous-shape architecture or approximation budget is accepted.
No extension to uncertain calibration, aging, variable-temperature physical proof or model-dependent weights.
No calibrated uncertainty/coverage, firmware readiness, target timing, complete SRAM or lifetime claim.
Acceptance is bound to exact A0 content hash; substantive changes require independent re-review.
